description:
We are a team of six working on an interactive space exploration simulation for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 – Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer.

Our goal is to develop an engaging, web-based mission simulator that allows users to experience the challenges of managing a lunar or Martian outpost by making critical decisions about oxygen, life support, energy, food production, radiation protection and resource management.
summary: ASTRA is an interactive 3D space exploration, astronaut survival, and planetary colony-building game designed to simulate the challenges of establishing human settlements beyond Earth. Players can explore the Moon and Mars, collect essential resources, complete missions, and manage survival parameters such as oxygen, hydration, nutrition, and health. The game features level-based progression, experience points, interactive objectives, resource management, and colony construction, allowing players to develop habitats, solar farms, greenhouses, and life-support facilities. By combining exploration, scientific activities, survival challenges, and strategic resource planning, ASTRA provides an engaging and educational experience that introduces players to the complexities of human space exploration and sustainable extraterrestrial habitation.
details:
ASTRA is a 3D planetary exploration, astronaut survival, and colony-building simulation that allows players to experience the challenges of establishing human settlements on the Moon and Mars. Players begin with a spacecraft and limited supplies, explore realistic planetary environments, collect and process resources, complete interactive missions, and manage essential survival parameters such as oxygen, hydration, nutrition, and health.

The game incorporates a level-based progression system in which players earn experience points (XP) through exploration, scientific experiments, resource collection, construction, equipment maintenance, and mission completion. As players advance, they unlock new regions, technologies, equipment, missions, and construction facilities. An interactive colony-building system allows players to gather materials and construct habitats, dome houses, solar farms, water storage facilities, oxygen generators, and greenhouses to establish sustainable settlements.

ASTRA aims to make space exploration concepts engaging and accessible through interactive gameplay. It introduces players to resource management, environmental challenges, scientific exploration, engineering, and sustainable habitation beyond Earth.

The project is developed using web-based 3D technologies, including JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Three.js, with Node.js supporting the development environment. The team focuses on combining immersive 3D environments, interactive simulations, gameplay progression, and educational concepts into a unified experience.
